description: Speed profiles of freeways in California (I5-S and I210-E) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Semin Kwak (EPFL). Speed profiles of freeways in California (I5-S and I210-E). Original data is retrieved from PeMS. Each YEAR_FREEWAY.csv file contains Timestamp and Speed data. freeway_meta.csv file contains meta information for each detector: freeway number, direction, detector ID, absolute milepost, and x y coordinates. Please refer the readme file. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
